title: Sharia-Compliance Workbook — Run Attestation v1 (LOCKED schema)
description: Single-run receipt embedded in every export. Carries the rule-pack identity + sha256, the offline assertion, export hashes for JSON and CSV, and a reviewer sign-off block the tool ALWAYS leaves blank. The HTML export embeds this attestation; its own hash is therefore computed post-hoc and is NOT inside the attestation (no circularity).

run_id.description: run-<UTC compact timestamp>-<first 8 hex of input_sha256>. Locally derivable, no RNG dependency.

clock_source.description: MVP clocks are the local wall clock; they are provenance metadata only, never used in verdict logic.

input_sha256.description: sha256 over canonical JSON of the case-input document.

results_sha256.description: sha256 over canonical JSON of the case-result document.

exports.description: Only the CSV export's hash may live here: the CSV carries a fixed header (run_id, input_id, rule_pack id/version/sha256, results_sha256) and not the attestation itself, so its hash is embeddable without circularity. The JSON export = {case_result, run_attestation} and the HTML export both embed this attestation verbatim; their file hashes are therefore recorded post-hoc in the delivery receipt and recomputed at verification time, never inside the attestation.

reviewer_signoff.description: HUMAN FIELD. The tool writes exactly this blank structure and NEVER populates it. No export is valid with a tool-filled sign-off (acceptance criterion A8).
